# Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史)

> Quantum Systems Engineer specializing in cloud-native quantum computing systems, calibration automation, and superconducting quantum computer operations

## About

Takafumi Miyanaga (宮永崇史) is a quantum systems engineer at Osaka University QIQB, specializing in cloud-native quantum computing systems, calibration automation, and superconducting quantum computer operations. He is the lead developer of OQTOPUS, an open-source software stack for operating cloud-accessible superconducting quantum processors, including 64- and 144-qubit systems, and designed QDash, a calibration orchestration platform for large-scale superconducting quantum processors.

## Key Projects

- OQTOPUS: Open Quantum Toolchain for OPerators & USers - https://oqtopus-team.github.io/
- oqtopus-cloud: Cloud-based quantum computing platform - https://github.com/oqtopus-team/oqtopus-cloud
- mirrormate: Your partner in the mirror - https://github.com/orangekame3/mirrormate
- tftarget: Interactive Terraform target selector - https://github.com/future-architect/tftarget

## Expertise

- Programming Languages: Go (Golang), Python, TypeScript/JavaScript
- Quantum Systems: Superconducting Qubits, Calibration Automation, Pulse-Level Control, Quantum Hardware Integration, Production Quantum Systems
- Quantum Software: OpenQASM 3.0, Cloud Quantum Computing, Job Scheduling, Device Gateway, Quantum Benchmarking
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, OpenTelemetry, Reliability Engineering
- Open Source Software Development

## Education & Career

- 2023 - Present: Specially Appointed Researcher, Osaka University QIQB
  - Lead developer of OQTOPUS, an open-source cloud quantum computing platform supporting 64- and 144-qubit superconducting systems
  - Designed software architecture spanning cloud APIs, job scheduling, execution backends, device gateway, user interfaces, observability, and production operations
  - Developed QDash for superconducting quantum processor calibration orchestration
  - Operated and maintained production quantum computing systems used by external researchers through cloud access
  - Automated calibration workflows and device health monitoring to improve operational efficiency and system reliability
- 2021 - 2023: Backend Engineer & Consultant, Future Corporation
- 2019 - 2021: M.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science (Superconducting Quantum Circuits)
- 2015 - 2019: B.S. Physics, Tokyo University of Science
